name: rw2_1
prompt: Two input images. IMAGE 1 is the full UI of a photoreal pedal steel guitar audio plugin. IMAGE 2 is a photograph of a real pedal steel guitar. Output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024: IMAGE 1 with its instrument REPLACED by the real instrument from IMAGE 2, re-photographed from IMAGE 1's camera (front-on from the player's side, centred, looking down about 45 degrees) under IMAGE 1's warm room light, standing on IMAGE 1's rug. Copy the real instrument faithfully: its slim rosewood-grain mica cabinet with the thin light inlay lines along the apron, its low flat aluminium neck, its compact keyhead with ten small tuners, its small low changer and pickup, its small square endplates, its long thin chrome legs with adjuster collars, its flat pale pedal bar lying on the floor between the front legs with small polished pedals, its thin pull rods and its knee levers, all at the real sizes and spacing relative to each other. Remove every logo, brand name and badge; no text on the instrument. The instrument fills the same width as the one in IMAGE 1 and its fretboard sits in the same place: keep IMAGE 1's black fretboard with coloured markers and numbers, exactly ten strings and the chrome tone bar where they are. Everything else in IMAGE 1 (rug, room, cream top bar, the whole dark control deck with all knobs, labels and switches) stays identical. It must look like a real photograph of a real instrument.
